description: This file implements the AzureTableGrainDirectory class, which manages grain directory entries stored in Azure Table Storage for Orleans. It provides methods for lookup, registration, and unregistration of grain addresses, integrating with Azure Data Tables and Orleans runtime lifecycle.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectory
classes.description: Manages grain directory entries using Azure Table Storage within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryEntity
classes.description: Represents a grain directory entry stored in Azure Table Storage, with methods to convert to/from GrainAddress.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves the GrainAddress for a given GrainId from Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a GrainAddress in Azure Table Storage, optionally replacing a previous address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a GrainAddress from Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Intended to unregister all grain addresses associated with given silos; not implemented for Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: InitializeIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes the Azure table if it doesn't exist, called during lifecycle startup.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the directory to the Orleans silo lifecycle events.

methods.name: GrainIdToRowKey
methods.description: Encodes a GrainId into a URL-encoded string for use as a row key.

methods.name: RowKeyToGrainId
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string into a GrainId.

methods.name: ToGrainAddress
methods.description: Converts a GrainDirectoryEntity to a GrainAddress object.

methods.name: FromGrainAddress
methods.description: Creates a GrainDirectoryEntity from a GrainAddress for storage.
